## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint test` passes (and `make race` if concurrency changed)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; bug fixes include a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `examples/pipeline.yaml`) for any config or behaviour change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased** for user-visible changes
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`); see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin-dco)
- [ ] Breaking changes (config keys, metric names) are called out above
